newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Pigeons carry diamonds in S.African mine scam.
newsitem.headline: Pigeons carry diamonds in S.African mine scam.

text.p: Thieves used carrier pigeons to fly stolen diamonds out of a South African mine, state television reported on Wednesday.
Police arrested 40 people and believed another 30 were involved in the scam at the state-owned Alexcor mine at Alexander Bay, near South Africa's border with Namibia.
Diamonds worth about one million rand ($220,000) were seized during the operation, which had taken a year to plan.
Thieves were believed to have used pigeons to carry their pickings out of the security areas on the mine, which is one of the companies on the government's list of privatisation candidates.
